== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Adessa is the [[Heiress]] of [[Damasca]] and a potential successor to her father's [[throne]]. Though she possesses a sharp political understanding, strategic intelligence, and significant charisma, she is considered unwise by some. She is often seen wearing the red and gold colors of her kingdom, though she carries herself with a soldier's demeanor. Adessa attempted to exploit a moment of vulnerability to seize power, an act her father deemed a betrayal of the [[Damascan]] people. As punishment for this treachery, she was stripped of her status and sentenced to permanent exile in the [[Territory]] of [[Lirial]] under the watch of [[Overlord Belanine]]. Despite her actions, she is noted as being mentally capable and possessing the qualities necessary to serve as a competent [[Queen]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Adessa possesses a keen grasp of politics and a shrewd strategic mind. She is the daughter of King Zakareth VI{{!}}King Zakareth and the older sister of [[Leah]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|She wields an artifact of Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus known as the [[Bleeding Wand]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The daughter of King Zakareth VI{{!}}King Zakareth, Adessa is the older sister of [[Leah]]. She wields the [[Bleeding Wand]], an artifact belonging to Ragnarus the Crimson Vault{{!}}Ragnarus. Despite her shrewd strategic mind and keen grasp of politics, she has been exiled.}}
